Established Ornamentals & Shrubs Rate (1,000 sq ft): 0.045 - 0.052 g Rate (100 m²): 0.017 - 0.020 oz Water Volume: 4-6 L (1.06-1.59 gal) Apply via irrigation during the growing season. Established Turf & Lawns Rate (1,000 sq ft): 0.058 - 0.069 g Rate (100 m²): 0.022 - 0.026 oz Water Volume: 10-15 L (2.64-3.96 gal) Apply via irrigation during the growing season.

Frequency: Apply once per growing season unless additional applications are required for recovery from stress or to maintain soil microbial activity.

Mixing & Application Tips

  • Use clean, chlorine-free water for best results. If using municipal water, let it stand for 24 hours before mixing.
  • Dissolve the product in clean water and apply using your chosen method.
  • Do not mix with fungicides or pesticides that may harm beneficial fungi.
  • Apply during the cooler parts of the day (morning or evening) to maintain fungal viability.
  • Store unused dry product in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Refrigerate any unused liquid solution.

Seasonal Timing

Early Spring

March - April
  • Apply at the start of the growing season or when planting seeds, seedlings, or sod. Encourages rapid root establishment and prepares plants for strong seasonal growth.

Mid-Spring to Early Summer

April - June
  • Apply during transplanting, early vegetative growth, or flowering to support nutrient uptake, water efficiency, and long-term soil health.

Mid-Summer

July
  • Use to help plants maintain root function and vitality during heat stress or drought. Beneficial for long-season crops, perennials, and turf that need sustained root activity.

Late Summer to Early Fall

August - September
  • Apply to strengthen root systems ahead of seasonal changes, ensuring plants store energy and nutrients for the next growing cycle.

Once Per Season:
 Myco Spora 10X typically requires only a single application per growing season; however, additional treatments can be applied after environmental stress or during replanting to maintain continuous benefits.

Common Questions & Tips

Can I apply Crop Aid Myco Spora 10X with other fertilizers or soil treatments?

Yes, it is generally compatible with most organic and inorganic soil amendments. Avoid mixing with fungicides or pesticides that may harm beneficial fungi. Always perform a jar test before mixing to check for compatibility.

Will overuse harm my plants?

Overapplication is unlikely to harm plants but may be wasteful. Myco Spora 10X is most effective at the recommended rate of 1 g per 2,000 m² (2,392 sq yd), applied once per season or after stress events.

How soon can I expect to see results?

Benefits begin below the soil surface immediately after colonization. Visible improvements in growth, vigour, and resilience are often noticeable within 3–6 weeks under good growing conditions.

Is Crop Aid Myco Spora 10X safe for edible plants and pets?

Yes, it can be used on edible plants and is safe for areas where pets are present when applied as directed.

Can I apply Myco Spora 10X during hot
weather?

Yes, but always apply early in the morning or late in the evening to maintain fungal viability and avoid excessive evaporation.

How often should I reapply for stressed plants?

Apply once per season under normal conditions. For plants recovering from drought, transplant shock, or nutrient deficiency, a second application may be made later in the season.

Can I use Myco Spora 10X in a greenhouse?

Absolutely. It works well in greenhouse and nursery environments when applied directly to the root zone.

Will rain wash off the
product?

Because it is a root-zone application, light rain after application generally helps move the product into the soil. However, avoid application just before heavy rainfall to prevent runoff.

Safety, Handling & Storage

Safe Use Guidelines

  • Use only as directed
  • Keep out of reach of children
  • Avoid contact with eyes or skin
  • Wear gloves, a dust mask, and goggles when handling large or frequent mixes to prevent inhaling dust particles.
  • Do not inhale spray mist
  • Wash your hands thoroughly after handling, even if you are wearing gloves.
  • Do not eat, drink, or smoke while using this product
  • Avoid application on windy days to minimize drift

First Aid

  • Eyes: Flush with clean water for 15 minutes. Seek medical attention if irritation persists.
  • Skin: Wash with soap and water. Seek medical help if irritation develops.
  • If swallowed: Do not induce vomiting. Drink water and seek immediate medical attention.
  • If inhaled: Move to fresh air; seek help if symptoms persist.
  • Clothing: Remove contaminated clothing immediately and wash before reuse.
  • If symptoms persist after any exposure, seek medical advice and provide the product label or safety sheet to the healthcare provider.

Storage Tips

  • Store in a sealed container in a cool, dry, well-ventilated location.
  • Protect from freezing and avoid exposure to excess moisture.
  • Keep the container tightly closed when not in use.
  • Store away from food, feed, and potable water supplies.
  • Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight or high heat.
  • The product contains living microorganisms; store it according to the label instructions to maintain viability.

Active Ingredients Declaration

All active ingredients in Crop Aid Myco Spora 10x are derived from registered and/or exempt materials and formulated in compliance with applicable Canadian and international agricultural standards.

item.title: Seasonal Tips for Thriving Plants Year-Round
item.dc:creator: Benjamin Garriott
item.content:encoded:
Practical, science-backed guidance to keep your soil, roots, and canopy performing at their best.

Why Seasonal Care Matters

Plants don’t live in a vacuum. Their needs shift with changing temperatures, soil conditions, and environmental stressors throughout the year. When growers match their care practices to these natural cycles, they give plants the best chance to thrive.

Seasonal care ensures:

  • Healthier soil that recycles nutrients and supports long-term fertility
  • Stronger root systems for efficient nutrient and water uptake
  • Resilient canopies that withstand stress from heat, drought, and pests
  • Better yields and quality, whether that’s flowers, fruit, turf, or vegetables

At Vertui, our Foundation to Finish program uses products designed to complement one another Soil Vitality Max, Myco Spora 10X, Root Ignite Bio, Hydro Balance Pro, Canopy Care Elite, and Vigor Spray Max giving you an integrated solution for every stage of growth.

By anticipating what plants need before stress hits, you can prevent setbacks and build resilience all season long.

Spring: Building the Foundation

Spring is the most important time to set your plants up for success. After winter dormancy, soils may be compacted, microbial activity can be low, and plants need a strong start.

Tips for Spring Success:

  • Replenish the soil with Soil Vitality Max: Restore microbial activity, reduce compaction, and build water-holding capacity before planting.
  • Balance your water with Hydro Balance Pro: Correct irrigation water pH to unlock nutrients and prevent lockout.
  • Strengthen roots with Root Ignite Bio: Use at planting or transplanting to kickstart root vigor and nutrient uptake.
  • Establish long-term support with Myco Spora 10X: Mix in water and apply as a root drench or dip to form lasting mycorrhizal networks (never apply dry).

A healthy start in spring sets the tone for the entire season.

Summer: Protecting and Sustaining Growth

Summer delivers rapid growth, longer days, and high energy but also stress. Heat waves, dry spells, and nutrient deficiencies are common challenges that can reduce yields or weaken plants if left unchecked.

Tips for Summer Growth:

  • Keep canopies thriving with Canopy Care Elite: Apply as a foliar spray every 2-3 weeks to strengthen photosynthesis, improve nutrient absorption, and protect against heat and drought stress.
  • Refresh the soil with Soil Vitality Max mid-season: Reinvigorate microbial life to sustain nutrient cycling during high-demand periods.
  • Build resilience with Vigor Spray Max: Alternate foliar applications with Canopy Care Elite to improve recovery after stress and sustain consistent growth.
  • Maintain nutrient delivery with Hydro Balance Pro: Keep irrigation water at the right pH for maximum nutrient efficiency.

Summer success is all about prevention don’t wait until plants show stress to act.

Fall: Recovery and Preparation

By the time fall arrives, plants have worked hard all season. Roots, soil, and canopies need recovery before dormancy. This is the time to restore strength and build reserves for next spring.

Tips for Fall Preparation:

  • Rebuild roots with Root Ignite Bio: Apply post-harvest to help roots recover and strengthen for winter.
  • Restore soil balance with Soil Vitality Max: Add organic matter and beneficial microbes to lock in fertility.
  • Extend fungal support with Myco Spora 10X (optional reapplication): In stressed or disturbed soils, reapply to maintain the underground network.
  • Stabilize nutrients with Hydro Balance Pro: Ensure recovery nutrients are absorbed efficiently as temperatures cool.

Fall is an investment healthy soil and roots now mean a faster, stronger start when spring returns.

Lawns & Turf: Year-Round Care

Lawns and turf require a slightly different approach: they don’t follow the same growth and harvest cycles as crops or ornamentals. Instead, consistency across all seasons is key.

Tips for Turf & Lawn Health:

  • Spring: Seed or overseed and apply Root Ignite Bio for quick root establishment. Use Myco Spora 10X in solution at seeding or sod installation for long-term fungal colonization.
  • Summer: Alternate foliar applications of Canopy Care Elite and Vigor Spray Max every few weeks to maintain canopy density and color.
  • Fall: Use Soil Vitality Max to repair microbial balance and Root Ignite Bio for root recovery ahead of dormancy.
  • Winter Prep: Finish the season with Soil Vitality Max to condition soil and retain nutrients for the spring.

The result? Lush, resilient lawns and turf that stay vibrant year-round.

Final Thoughts

Seasonal plant care isn’t just about reacting to problems it’s about anticipating them. By giving your plants what they need at the right time, you create healthier soil, stronger roots, and resilient canopies that perform year after year.

At Vertui, we believe in a foundation-to-finish approach:

  • Soil Vitality Max - revitalize soil biology and structure
  • Myco Spora 10X - build season-long fungal root partnerships
  • Root Ignite Bio - jumpstart root vigor at planting and transplanting
  • Hydro Balance Pro - optimize irrigation water for efficient nutrient use
  • Canopy Care Elite - protect and strengthen canopies through stress
  • Vigor Spray Max - sustain plant vigor and resilience throughout the season

When these tools are aligned with the seasons, the result is simple: plants that grow stronger, recover faster, and deliver more.

  • Winter Prep: Finish the season with Soil Vitality Max to condition soil and retain nutrients for the spring.

The result? Lush, resilient lawns and turf that stay vibrant year-round.

Final Thoughts

Seasonal plant care isn’t just about reacting to problems it’s about anticipating them. By giving your plants what they need at the right time, you create healthier soil, stronger roots, and resilient canopies that perform year after year.

At Vertui, we believe in a foundation-to-finish approach:

  • Soil Vitality Max - revitalize soil biology and structure
  • Myco Spora 10X - build season-long fungal root partnerships
  • Root Ignite Bio - jumpstart root vigor at planting and transplanting
  • Hydro Balance Pro - optimize irrigation water for efficient nutrient use
  • Canopy Care Elite - protect and strengthen canopies through stress
  • Vigor Spray Max - sustain plant vigor and resilience throughout the season

When these tools are aligned with the seasons, the result is simple: plants that grow stronger, recover faster, and deliver more.

item.title: QR Hydro Balance Pro
item.dc:creator: Benjamin Garriott
item.content:encoded:
Explore More at Vertui.com Precision Balance, Maximum Growth

Hydro Balance
Pro

Balance Your Water, Empower
Your Plants

Achieve Perfect Water Balance Today!

Hydro Balance Pro
Product Overview

Hydro Balance Pro is a professional-grade water conditioner and pH adjuster that optimizes irrigation water quality to enhance plant hydration, nutrient absorption, and resilience. By softening water, reducing total dissolved solids, and adjusting pH, it prevents nutrient lockout and salt stress, unlocking the full potential of every drop you apply.

Formulated with food-grade citric acid and no harmful additives, Hydro Balance Pro is ideal for gardens, lawns, greenhouses, and commercial settings. It’s pet-safe, dye-free, and compatible with your existing fertilizer program.

Key Benefits

Adjusts Water pH

Balances irrigation water to reduce plant stress and promote optimal hydration. Helps maintain a stable root-zone environment for consistent growth

Improves Nutrient Uptake

Optimizes pH to minimize nutrient lockout, allowing plants to absorb essential nutrients efficiently

Mitigates Salt Stress

Neutralizes the harmful effects of irrigation salt buildup, protecting roots and maintaining soil health

Enhances Fertilizer Compatibility

Softens hard water to improve the performance of fertilizers and biological treatments, preventing mineral interference

Highly Concentrated & Cost-Effective

Small dosages treat large areas, providing efficient and economical application for growers

Pet & Family
Safe

Non-toxic and dye-free, safe for lawns and gardens frequented by pets or children.

Struggling with Water Quality?

Hydro Balance Pro was developed specifically for gardeners and growers who are dealing with:

Hard, Alkaline Water?

Hydro Balance Pro softens and adjusts your water to the ideal pH range (5.5-7.0), ensuring optimal hydration and nutrient absorption

Nutrient Lockout or Salt Buildup?

Combat salinity stress and improve nutrient delivery directly at the root level, allowing plants to access essential minerals

Inconsistent Growth
or Poor Yields

Balance your water and create a stable environment that promotes steady, vigorous growth from seedling to harvest

Compatibility Issues with Other Treatments

Chelating action helps soften water and reduce mineral interference, making fertilizers and supplements more effective

Sensitive or High-Value
Plants

Protect delicate plants from pH swings and mineral stress while maintaining optimal growing conditions

Variable Water
Sources

Maintain consistent water quality when switching between municipal, well, or surface water sources

How Hydro Balance Works

Hydro Balance Pro contains food-grade citric acid, a natural chelating agent.

  • Here’s why it works:
  • Softens water by binding with excess minerals: Prevents buildup that can harm roots and clog irrigation systems, keeping water flow clean and efficient
  • Reduces total dissolved solids (TDS): Improves water quality for better plant hydration and nutrient absorption
  • Improves nutrient delivery and soil penetration: Helps nutrients move through soil more effectively to reach plant roots, supporting healthier growth and yields
  • Maintains compatibility with fertilizers and biostimulants: Prevents reactions that reduce product effectiveness, ensuring treatments work as intended
  • Protects your plants from chemical burn and imbalanced hydration: Minimizes the risk of over-fertilization damage and uneven moisture distribution

Hydro Balance Pro delivers cleaner water, improved nutrient use, and safer growing conditions, helping plants thrive from root to bloom.

When to Use Hydro Balance Pro

Soil Preparation & Irrigation Setup

Use Hydro Balance Pro:

Before planting or
transplanting

During early root
development

When mixing fertilizers or foliar sprays

Incorporate this into every watering or fertigation cycle to maintain pH within the target range, enhance nutrient uptake, and preserve soil health from planting to harvest

Guaranteed Analysis

  • Active Ingredient: Food-Grade Citric Acid
    (Chelating Agent & pH Adjuster)

Food-grade citric acid is a naturally derived compound recognized for its effectiveness in adjusting water pH and binding with excess minerals. As a chelating agent, it enhances the solubility and mobility of essential nutrients, ensuring they are more available for plant uptake. By controlling mineral buildup and reducing total dissolved solids (TDS), it prevents nutrient lockout and helps maintain optimal soil conditions. Its role as a pH adjuster ensures consistent water quality, supporting balanced hydration, healthy root development, and improved overall plant performance. Hydro Balance Pro’s active ingredient works in harmony with fertilizers, biostimulants, and other treatments to maximize their efficiency while protecting plants from chemical stress and imbalanced moisture levels.

Coverage

250 mL (8.5 US fl oz)

Treats up to 1,893 L (500 gallons), covering 10,000-25,000 sq ft (929-2,323 sq m)

500 mL (17 US fl oz)

Treats up to 3,785 L (1,000 gallons), covering 20,000-50,000 sq ft (1,858-4,645 sq m)

Coverage varies based on water alkalinity and the intensity of treatment

When to Apply Hydro Balance Pro

Vegetables & Garden Beds

When to Apply

  • During initial irrigation, before planting seeds or transplanting seedlings.
  • For long-season crops (such as tomatoes, peppers, and cabbage), reapply every 3-4 weeks to maintain optimal pH and nutrient availability.

Pro Tips

  • Test water pH before and after application to fine-tune dosage.
  • Use during fertigation to ensure nutrient compatibility and absorption.

Fruit Trees, Vines & Berries

When to Apply

  • At planting for new trees, vines, or berry bushes to set the root-zone conditions.
  • For established fruit, apply early in the growing season, before flowering, to reduce salinity stress.

Pro Tips

  • Apply through drip irrigation or as a root-zone drench to maximize penetration and effectiveness.
  • Target applications before heavy feeding periods for best results.

Flowers & Ornamentals

When to Apply

  • Prior to planting beds or containers to balance the water pH.
  • Mid-season to refresh soil conditions and maintain consistent hydration.

Pro Tips

  • Use in combination with liquid feeds to prevent nutrient lockout.
  • Avoid runoff by watering in evenly.

Lawns & Turf

When to Apply

  • At the establishment of new lawns or when overseeding existing turf.
  • Early spring and late summer to early fall are ideal times to prepare for seasonal stress and manage soil salinity.

Pro Tips

  • Apply evenly with a hose-end sprayer or through irrigation systems.
  • Mow to a moderate height before application for improved soil contact.

How to Apply Hydro Balance Pro

Irrigation Water Conditioning

  • Mild adjustment: Mix 5-10 mL (0.17-0.34 US fl oz) per 38 L(10 gallons) of water.
  • Moderate adjustment: Mix 10-20 mL (0.34-0.68 US fl oz) per 38 L (10 gallons) of water.
  • Severe adjustment: Mix 20-30 mL (0.68-1.01 US fl oz) per 38 litres (10 gallons) of water.
  • Add the product gradually while stirring. Test the water pH before and after application.

Sprayer Tank Application

  • Add Hydro Balance Pro before fertilizers or other inputs.
  • Stir well for even distribution.
  • Foliar spray: 3.8 L (1 gallon) of treated water covers 500-1,000 sq ft (46-93 sq m).

Drip & Overhead Irrigation Systems

  • Inject at the start of the irrigation cycle to precondition water.
  • Improves nutrient compatibility and prevents mineral precipitation.

Corrective Applications

  • High alkalinity correction: For water with a pH greater than 8.0, use a higher rate within the severe adjustment range to bring the pH down to 5.5-7.0.
  • Salinity management: Apply periodically in saline-prone soils to flush excess salts from the root zone.

Mixing & Application Tips

  • Use non-chlorinated water whenever possible; let municipal water sit for at least 24 hours before use.
  • Mix thoroughly before and during application.
  • Apply during cooler parts of the day; avoid heat stress conditions.
  • Test water pH before and after to fine-tune dosage.
  • Store in a cool, dry place, keeping the container sealed.

Seasonal Timing

Early Spring

March - April
  • Condition irrigation water before the start of active growth to ensure optimal pH and nutrient availability.
  • Ideal for early-season vegetables, lawns, and ornamental plantings.

Mid-Spring to Early Summer

May - June
  • Apply during seeding, transplanting, or early vegetative growth to support strong establishment.
  • Maintain balanced water conditions for fruit set and early crop development.

Mid-Summer

July
  • Use to manage high-alkalinity water and salinity stress during peak irrigation demand.
  • Supports sustained growth and flowering in long-season crops and ornamentals.

Late Summer to Early Fall

August - September
  • Prepare lawns and fall crops by reducing soil salts and balancing pH before cooler weather.
  • Helps perennial plants and turf recover from summer stress.

Reapply as needed whenever irrigation water pH rises above the target range or salinity stress is detected, especially in high-alkalinity or saline-prone conditions. For ongoing pH management in greenhouses or high-value planting, regular use with each irrigation cycle is recommended.

Common Questions & Tips

Will it hurt plants if overused?

It may lower the pH too far. Adhere to dosage guidelines and always verify accuracy.

Can I use this in a greenhouse drip system?

Yes! It’s compatible with most irrigation setups.

What results can I expect?

Healthier foliage, improved nutrient performance, and better soil hydration within 1–2 weeks.

Is it safe for pets and edible gardens?

Yes. Hydro Balance Pro is non-toxic and food-safe when used as directed.

Can I mix Hydro Balance Pro with fertilizers?

Yes, it’s designed to maintain compatibility with most fertilizers and biostimulants. Always perform a jar test first to confirm the results.

How do I know when to reapply?

Reapply whenever water pH drifts above the target range or salinity issues are detected, especially in high-alkalinity or saline-prone areas.

Will it help with hard water scale in irrigation lines?

Yes. Its chelating action binds excess minerals, helping prevent scale buildup in emitters and lines.

Can it be used for foliar applications?

Yes, it can be applied as a foliar spray when diluted according to label instructions, helping condition water for optimal leaf uptake.

Safety, Handling & Storage

Safe Use Guidelines

  • Use only as directed.
  • Keep out of reach of children.
  • Avoid contact with the eyes or skin.
  • Wear gloves and goggles for large or frequent mixes.
  • Do not inhale spray mist.
  • Wash your hands thoroughly after handling, even if you are wearing gloves.
  • Do not eat, drink, or smoke while using this product.
  • Avoid application on windy days to minimize drift.

First Aid

  • Eyes: Flush with clean water for 15 minutes.
  • Skin: Wash with soap and water.
  • If Swallowed: Drink water, seek immediate medical attention.
  • If inhaled: Move to fresh air; seek help if symptoms persist.
  • Clothing: Remove contaminated clothing immediately and wash before reuse.
  • If symptoms persist after any exposure, seek medical advice and provide the product label or safety sheet to the healthcare provider.

Storage Tips

  • Store in a sealed container in a cool, dry, well-ventilated location.
  • Protect from freezing.
  • Keep container tightly closed when not in use.
  • Store away from food, feed, and potable water supplies.
  • Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight or high heat.

Active Ingredients Declaration

All active ingredients in Hydro Balance Pro are derived from registered and/or exempt materials and formulated in compliance with applicable Canadian and international agricultural standards.

About Vertui Horticulture

Hydro Balance Pro was developed specifically for gardeners and growers by Vertui Horticulture Ltd., a Crop Aid Nutrition Ltd. company founded by a Saskatchewan farmer with over 20 years of experience in global soil health. We combine scientific research and sustainable practice for performance you can trust.

Our mission is to deliver high-performance, environmentally responsible solutions that empower growers at every level, from backyard gardens to professional growing operations.

item.dc:creator: Benjamin Garriott
item.content:encoded:
Explore More at Vertui.com Ignite Root Growth

Root
Ignite
Bio

Stronger Roots

Ignite Your Garden’s Potential Today!

Root Ignite Bio
Product Overview

Root Ignite Bio is a super-concentrated, liquid bio-stimulant designed as a seed treatment and transplant aid to optimize root growth, early plant development, and stress resilience. Safe for use on lawns, gardens, vegetables, and ornamental plants, this solution provides scientifically supported, field-tested results using a powerful combination of nutrients and biological inputs.

Formulated with beneficial mycorrhizal fungi and essential minerals, Root Ignite Bio enhances soil-root interactions, fostering healthier plant foundations without staining equipment or harming pets.

Key Benefits

Promotes Rapid Root Establishment

Triggers rapid lateral and vertical root expansion to give plants a strong start and enhanced soil anchorage.

Enhances Nutrient Absorption

Enhances the plant’s ability to extract water and macro- and micronutrients from the soil, particularly in low-fertility or compacted environments.

Improves Early
Vigor

Encourages healthy germination and stronger shoot and leaf growth, reducing early-stage plant loss.

Minimizes Seedling Stress

Increases tolerance to abiotic stress such as drought, transplant shock, and temperature fluctuations.

Improves Soil Health

Supports the development of beneficial microbial communities and strengthens soil structure for long-term productivity. Pet & Family Safe

Pet & Family Safe

Non-toxic, dye-free, and safe for use in family gardens, lawns, and outdoor spaces used by pets and children.

Struggling with Soil or Seedlings?

Root Ignite Bio was developed specifically for gardeners and growers who are dealing with:

Compacted or Tired Soil?

Energizes the root zone with beneficial fungi, minerals, and bio-stimulants to improve soil structure, break compaction, and promote healthy root growth.

Seedlings Not Taking Off?

Boosts early root expansion, helping young plants anchor quickly and adapt to stress from day one.

Slow Germination Rates

Delivers a concentrated nutrient boost to help seeds sprout faster and more evenly, resulting in stronger starts.

Poor Early Root Development

Stimulates deeper, stronger roots for better water and nutrient uptake throughout the season.

Transplant Shock

Reduces stress in newly planted crops, supporting faster root recovery and resilience.

Weak Plant Vigor

Improves nutrient absorption and enhances plants' ability to withstand adverse conditions.

How Root Ignite Bio Works

Root Ignite Bio contains endophytic mycorrhizal fungi that form a symbiotic
partnership with plant roots.

  • Here’s why it works:
  • Increases Root Surface Area: Extends the root system's reach through fine fungal filaments, enabling plants to access more water and nutrients from a larger soil volume.
  • Boosts Phosphorus & Trace Mineral Absorption: Unlocks and delivers hard-to-reach nutrients, including phosphorus, zinc, and other essential micronutrients, for stronger growth and flowering.
  • Enhances Stress Tolerance: Improves root resilience against salinity, compacted soils, and drought by optimizing water regulation and nutrient efficiency.
  • Strengthens Soil Structure: Binds soil particles into stable aggregates that enhance aeration, drainage, and root penetration, while reducing soil erosion.
  • Enhances Root–Soil Microbiome Interaction: Cultivates a balanced and beneficial microbial community around the roots, promoting long-term plant resilience and performance.

Root Ignite Bio utilizes beneficial fungi to enhance root reach, boost nutrient uptake, improve water access, and strengthen soil health, providing plants with the foundation they need to thrive.

When to Use Root Ignite Bio

Seed Germination & Early Root Development

Apply Root Ignite Bio when:

Seeds are germinating and require optimal conditions for sprouting and establishment

Plants need a boost to develop strong, healthy root systems

You want to lay a solid foundation for nutrient uptake and long-term plant growth

Use at seeding or transplanting for optimal results. Follow the mixing and application instructions. Reapply every 3-4 weeks during the early growth phase if additional root support is needed, based on crop and soil conditions.

Guaranteed Minimum Nutrient Analysis

Nutrient ComponentPercentageDescription
Total Nitrogen(N)2.00%Supports leafy growth and overall vigour, especially critical during early seedling development.
Available Phosphoric Acid(P₂O₅)6.00%Boosts root development and flower/fruit formation; essential for energy transfer (ATP) in plant cells.
Soluble Potash(K₂O)1.00% Enhances disease resistance, water regulation, and enzymatic function; supports sturdy stems and root resilience.
Sulphur(S)1.00%Key for amino acids and proteins; improves chlorophyll synthesis and flavour in vegetables.
Ammonium LignosulphonateChelating Agent2.50%Aids in binding and delivering micronutrients like iron and zinc, improving root uptake efficiency.
Zinc(Zn)0.10%Stimulates hormone production (auxins) and enzyme activity; supports shoot elongation and leaf growth.
Iron(Fe)0.10%Essential for chlorophyll production; prevents interveinal yellowing in young leaves (iron chlorosis).
Manganese(Mn)0.08%Vital for photosynthesis, nitrogen metabolism, and defence against oxidative stress.
Boron(B)0.04%Regulates cell wall formation and pollen viability, both of which are crucial for reproductive success and root elongation.
Kelp Extract(Ascophyllum Nodosum)0.25%Natural source of growth hormones (cytokinins, auxins), trace minerals, and stress protectants.

Coverage

250 mL (8.5 US fl oz)

Treats approximately 8.3-10 L (2.2-2.64 US gallons) of solution, covering up to 43,560 sq ft (4,047 sq m)

500 mL (17 US fl oz)

Treats approximately 16.6-20 L (4.4-5.28 US gallons) of solution, covering up to 87,120 sq ft (8,094 sq m)

Coverage may vary based on crop type, soil condition, and application method. Always follow label directions for best results.

When to Apply Root Ignite Bio

Vegetables & Garden Beds

When to Apply

  • At direct seeding or transplanting seedlings.
  • For long-season crops (such as tomatoes, peppers, and cabbage), reapply every 3-4 weeks after transplanting to maintain continued root support.

Pro Tips

  • Water the soil immediately after application.
  • Focus on compacted or nutrient-poor beds for maximum benefit.

Fruit Trees, Vines & Berries

When to Apply

  • At planting for new trees, vines, or berry plants.
  • For established fruit, apply early in the season before flowering.

Pro Tips

  • Apply as a root drench around the drip line where feeder roots are most active.
  • Avoid waterlogged soils to improve fungal colonization.

Flowers & Ornamentals

When to Apply

  • At transplanting from trays or pots to beds.
  • Early in the flowering season, for perennials, to stimulate root activity.

Pro Tips

  • Dip bare roots or plugs before planting.
  • Mulch after application to retain moisture.

Lawns & Turf

When to Apply

  • At seeding for new lawns or overseeding existing turf.
  • In early spring and late summer/early fall, to prepare for seasonal stress.

Pro Tips

  • Apply evenly with a broadcast sprayer.
  • Mow to a moderate height before application for better soil contact.

How to Apply Root Ignite Bio

Seeding In-Furrow or Over Soil

  • Mix 25-30 mL (0.85-1 US fl oz) per 1 L (34 US fl oz) of water.
  • Apply to furrows or the soil surface just before or during planting.
  • Use a clean sprayer with a fine mist or fan nozzle for even coverage.

Transplanting & Root Dip

  • Mix 17 mL (0.57 oz US) per 1 L (34 oz US) of water.
  • Dip bare roots or cuttings for a few seconds before planting.
  • DO NOT OVER-SOAK. Brief contact is sufficient.

Optional Applications

Seed Coating

  • Mix 10 mL (0.34 US fl oz) per 1 lb (0.45 kg) of seed
  • Evenly coat the seed before sowing for enhanced germination and early root growth

Lawn & Garden Broadcast Spray

  • Mix 5.7 mL (0.193 oz US) of product per 1,000 sq ft (93 sq m)
  • Dilute in 4–8 L of water (1–2 U.S. gallons) of water, depending on sprayer type and desired coverage
  • Apply evenly for general bio-activation of the topsoil.

Mixing & Application Tips

  • Use non-chlorinated water whenever possible. If using municipal water, let it stand for 24 hours to allow the chlorine to dissipate
  • Mix thoroughly before and during application to keep the product evenly suspended
  • Apply in cooler parts of the day when the soil is moist and not waterlogged
  • Lightly water after application to move the product into the root zone and activate microbial activity
  • Store in a cool, dry place and use within the season for best results

Seasonal Timing

Early Spring

March - April
  • Kick-start root activity before the onset of rapid growth.

Mid-Spring to Early Summer

March - June
  • Apply during seeding, transplanting, or early vegetative growth.

Mid-Summer

July
  • Optional mid-season boost for long-seasons and perennials.

Late Summer to Early Fall

August - September
  • Strengthen roots for lawns and fall-planted vegetables before winter.

Reapply Every 3-4 Weeks:
 For high-value planting or stressed soils during active growth

Common Questions & Tips

Can I apply too much?

Yes. Stick to the rates to protect beneficial fungi and avoid salt stress.

Will this help in sandy or poor soil?

Yes. Root Ignite Bio is ideal for low-nutrient, dry, or compacted conditions.

Can I mix this with fertilizers or other treatments?

Yes, Root Ignite Bio is compatible with most fertilizers and biostimulants. Avoid mixing with high-chlorine or strongly acidic/alkaline solutions.

Does it need to be watered in after application?

Light watering after application helps move the product into the root zone and activate the fungi.

When can I expect to see results?

Most users observe improved vigor and root growth within 1-3 weeks.

Is this safe for pets and edibles?

Yes. Non-toxic, dye-free, and safe for family gardens.

Can I use it in containers or raised beds?

Absolutely. Apply at the same rates as in-ground planting for potted plants, raised beds, or greenhouse use.

How should I store it?

Keep sealed in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Do not allow the product to freeze.

Safety, Handling & Storage

Safe Use Guidelines

  • Use only as directed
  • Keep out of reach of children
  • Avoid contact with eyes or skin
  • Wear gloves and goggles for large or frequent mixes
  • Do not inhale spray mist
  • Wash your hands thoroughly after handling, even if you are wearing gloves.
  • Do not eat, drink, or smoke while using this product
  • Avoid application on windy days to minimize drift

First Aid

  • Eyes: Flush with clean water for 15 minutes
  • Skin: Wash with soap and water
  • If Swallowed: Drink water, seek immediate medical attention
  • If Inhaled: Move to fresh air; seek help if symptoms persist.
  • Clothing: Remove contaminated clothing immediately and wash before reuse.
  • If symptoms persist after any exposure, seek medical advice and provide the product label or safety sheet to the healthcare provider.

Storage Tips

  • Store in a sealed container in a cool, dry, well-ventilated location.
  • Protect from freezing.
  • Keep the container tightly closed when not in use.
  • Store away from food, feed, and potable water supplies.
  • Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight or high heat.
  • The product contains active micronutrients; use according to soil test results for optimal safety.

Active Ingredients Declaration

All active ingredients in Root Ignite Bio are derived from registered and/or exempt materials and formulated in compliance with applicable Canadian and international agricultural standards.

About Vertui Horticulture

Root Ignite Bio was developed specifically for gardeners and growers by Vertui Horticulture Ltd., a Crop Aid Nutrition Ltd., company founded by a Saskatchewan farmer with over 20 years of experience in global soil health. item.title: QR Soil Vitality Max
item.dc:creator: Benjamin Garriott
item.content:encoded:
Explore More at Vertui.com Maximize Soil Health, Naturally

Soil Vitality
Max

Revitalize Roots, Enhance Growth

Unlock the Power of Healthy Soil Today!

Soil Vitality Max
Product Overview

Soil Vitality Max is a carbon-based bio-stimulant that revitalizes soil, boosts microbial activity, and improves nutrient efficiency. Its advanced formula helps reduce compaction, enhance water retention, and create a healthier environment for roots, so plants grow stronger and more resilient.

Ideal for flowers, vegetables, lawns, and ornamentals, Soil Vitality Max works below the surface to support vibrant growth and higher yields. Safe for use around the home and garden, it’s easy to apply, compatible with most methods, and delivers noticeable results with minimal effort.

Key Benefits

Strengthens Soil Microbial Activity

Encourages a thriving community of beneficial microbes that improve nutrient cycling, enhance root health, and support long-term soil vitality for sustained plant growth.

Reduces Soil
Compaction

Breaks down hardpan layers and loosens dense, compacted soil, allowing for better water infiltration, improved aeration, and easier root penetration.

Improves Water
Retention

Helps the soil retain moisture for longer periods, reducing plant stress during hot or dry conditions and minimizing the need for frequent watering.

Boosts Fertilizer
Efficiency

Acts as a natural catalyst to improve nutrient uptake, ensuring plants get more from each fertilizer application while minimizing nutrient loss through leaching.

Promotes Robust Plant Growth

Supports strong early root establishment and vigorous vegetative growth, leading to healthier, more productive plants and higher-quality yields.

Pet & Family
Safe

Non-toxic, dye-free formula that is safe for use on lawns, gardens, and outdoor areas frequented by pets, children, and wildlife.

Struggling with Soil Problems?

Soil Vitality Max was developed specifically for gardeners
and growers who are dealing with:

Compacted, Dry Soil

Hard-packed soil stops roots from spreading, blocks water from soaking in, and keeps nutrients out of reach.

Lacklustre Plant Growth

When plants appear thin, stunted, or slow to grow, it often indicates that the soil lacks structure or vital microbial life.

Poor Water Retention

Water runs off instead of being absorbed, leaving plants thirsty and washing away valuable nutrients.

Low Nutrient Uptake

Fertilizers can’t work if nutrients stay locked in the soil, leaving plants underfed despite regular feeding.

Uneven Lawn or Garden Performance

Some areas thrive, while others remain bare or yellow, often due to inconsistent moisture, compaction, or nutrient deficiencies.

Tired, Depleted Soil

Over time, soil can lose organic matter and life, making it harder to sustain healthy, vigorous plants.

How Soil Vitality Max Works

Soil Vitality Max is a carbon-based liquid biostimulant that transforms tired or compacted soils into thriving, plant-supportive ecosystems.

  • Here’s why it works:
  • Feeds Beneficial Soil Microbes: Enhances microbial activity to promote nutrient cycling and accelerate the breakdown of organic matter.
  • Breaks Down Soil Compaction: Loosens hardpan and dense soils, allowing for increased water and air movement to the roots.
  • Chelates Nutrients for Easier Uptake: Contains Ammonium Lignosulphonate, a natural chelating agent that unlocks tied-up minerals like iron and zinc.
  • Delivers Marine-Derived Kelp Extract: Ascophyllum Nodosum improves root health, stress tolerance, and early vigour.
  • Reduces Harmful Pathogens: Creates a more biologically balanced
    soil by suppressing unwanted pathogens through the competitive dominance of beneficial microbes.

Soil Vitality Max supports the living system beneath your plants, ensuring that the roots receive the oxygen, water, and nutrients they need to thrive.

When to Use Soil Vitality Max

Soil Enrichment & Vegetative Growth

Apply Soil Vitality Max when:

Soil shows signs of compaction or nutrient imbalance

Plants are establishing roots or entering active growth

You want to boost resilience before stress (drought, heat, or cold)

Use early in the season and reapply every 3-4 weeks for best results.

Guaranteed Minimum Analysis

Nutrient Component Percentage Description
Ammonium Lignosulphonate 6.3% A natural chelating agent that binds with essential nutrients, keeping them in a plant-available form for improved uptake and efficiency.
Zinc  (Zn)  0.20% Vital for enzyme activation, chlorophyll production, and healthy leaf development, especially during early growth stages.
Iron (Fe) 0.18% Essential for chlorophyll synthesis and overall plant vigour, preventing yellowing (chlorosis) in leaves.
Manganese (Mn) 0.18% Supports photosynthesis and helps activate enzymes involved in nitrogen metabolism.
Boron (B)  0.08% Critical for cell wall formation, root tip health, and reproductive growth, including flowering and fruit set.
Ascophyllum Nodosum (Kelp Extract)  0.90%  Marine plant extract that stimulates root growth, enhances stress tolerance, and supports overall plant resilience.

Coverage

250 mL (8.5 US fl oz)

Treats up to 1,893 L (500 gallons), covering up to 43,560 sq ft (4,047 sq m).

500 mL (17 US fl oz)

Treats up to 3,785 L (1,000 gallons), covering up to 87,120 sq ft (8,094 sq m).

Coverage may vary depending on the application method, soil conditions, and the type of plant.

When to Apply Soil Vitality Max

Vegetables & Garden Beds

When to Apply

  • At soil preparation, direct seeding, or transplanting seedlings.
  • Reapply every 3-4 weeks during active growth, especially before anticipated periods of stress (such as heat, drought, or cold).

Pro Tips

  • Water the area lightly before and immediately after application for optimal penetration.
  • Target compacted or nutrient-deficient soil for maximum improvement in microbial activity and water retention.

Fruit Trees, Vines & Berries

When to Apply

  • When planting new trees, vines, or berry plants, establish a strong root system to ensure their long-term health.
  • For established plants, apply early in the growing season before flowering, and again mid-season to maintain soil health.

Pro Tips

  • Apply as a soil drench around the drip line where feeder roots are most active.
  • Avoid applying to waterlogged soils to improve oxygen availability and maintain a healthy microbial balance.

Flowers & Ornamentals

When to Apply

  • At transplanting from trays or pots to garden beds or containers.
  • Early in the season, for perennials to stimulate root development and soil vitality.

Pro Tips

  • Lightly mist the root zone before planting.
  • Apply before mulching to allow the product to integrate directly into the soil.

Lawns & Turf

When to Apply

  • At seeding for new lawns or when overseeding to boost germination success.
  • In early spring to jumpstart growth and in late summer/early fall to prepare for seasonal stress.

Pro Tips

  • Apply evenly using a broadcast or yard sprayer at the recommended dilution rate of 10-15 mL (0.34-0.51 US fl oz) in 1 L (34 US fl oz) of water.
  • Mow to a moderate height before application for improved soil contact.

How to Apply Soil Vitality Max

Foliar Spray or Soil Drench

  • Mix 10-15 mL (0.3-0.51 US fl oz) per 1 L (34 US fl oz) of water.
  • Foliar: Apply a fine mist to leaves until just before droplets form - do not oversaturate.
  • Soil Drench: Apply directly to the base of plants for root zone absorption.

Yard or Backpack Sprayer (Lawns & Large Areas)

  • Mix 10-15 mL (0.34-0.51 US fl oz) per 1 L (34 US fl oz) of water.
  • Apply evenly across the surface for consistent coverage.
  • Avoid applying to waterlogged soils for best microbial activation.

Garden Beds, Containers & Raised Planters

  • Mix 10-15 mL (0.34-0.51 US fl oz) per 1 L (34 US fl oz) of water.
  • Apply during planting or as a mid-season boost every 3-4 weeks.
  • Target compacted or nutrient-deficient zones for maximum benefit.

Optional Targeted Boost

  • Spot Treatments: Use at standard mix rate on stressed or yellowing patches to restore soil balance.
  • Seasonal Preparation: Apply in early spring to jumpstart microbial activity, and again in late fall to condition soil for winter.

Mixing & Application Tips

  • Use non-chlorinated water whenever possible. If using municipal water, allow it to stand for 24 hours to allow the chlorine to dissipate.
  • Mix thoroughly before and during application to keep the product evenly suspended.
  • Apply in cooler parts of the day when the soil is moist but not saturated.
  • Lightly water after application to move the product into the root zone.
  • Store in a cool, dry place in its sealed container.

Seasonal Timing

Early Spring

March - April
  • Jump-start microbial activity and improve soil structure before plants enter rapid growth. Ideal for lawns, gardens, and perennials emerging from dormancy.

Mid-Spring to Early Summer

May - June
  • Apply during seeding, transplanting, or early vegetative growth to maximize nutrient uptake and root establishment.

Mid-Summer

July
  • Optional mid-season application to sustain soil vitality, improve water retention, and reduce stress during heat and drought periods.

Late Summer to Early Fall

August - September
  • Strengthen soil health before winter. Apply to lawns, late-season vegetables, and perennial beds to retain nutrients and improve root resilience.

Reapply Every 3-4 Weeks:
For your most cared-for plants, delicate blooms, or stressed soils during active growth, maintain a regular application schedule for best results.

Common Questions & Tips

Can I apply too much?

Yes. Always follow the recommended application rates to avoid oversaturation, which can reduce oxygen in the root zone and slow microbial activity.

Will this help in sandy, clay, or poor soil?

Yes. Soil Vitality Max is designed to enhance soil structure, stimulate microbial activity, and improve water retention in sandy, clay, compacted, or nutrient-deficient soils.

Can I use it in containers, raised beds, or
greenhouses?

Absolutely. Apply at the same rates as in-ground applications for potted plants, raised beds, and greenhouse crops.

When will I see results?

Many users notice healthier, more resilient plants within 3-6 weeks, with improved growth, root development, and soil condition over time.

Is this safe for pets, children, and edible plants?

 Yes. Soil Vitality Max is non-toxic, dye-free, and safe for use in family gardens, lawns, and around pets and wildlife.

Do I need to water it in after application?

Light watering after application helps move the product into the root zone and activates the soil microbes for best results.

Can I mix this with fertilizers or other
treatments?

Yes. Soil Vitality Max is compatible with most fertilizers, herbicides, and garden treatments. Avoid mixing with high-chlorine or strongly acidic/alkaline solutions.

How should I store Soil Vitality Max?

Keep sealed in its original container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Do not freeze-store at ambient temperature for best shelf life.

Safety, Handling & Storage

Safe Use Guidelines

  • Use only as directed.
  • Keep out of reach of children,
  • Avoid contact with the eyes or skin.
  • Wear gloves and goggles for large or frequent mixes.
  • Do not inhale spray mist.
  • Wash your hands thoroughly after handling, even if you are wearing gloves.
  • Do not eat, drink, or smoke while using this product.
  • Avoid application on windy days to minimize drift.

First Aid

  • Eyes: Flush with clean water for 15 minutes.
  • Skin: Wash with soap and water.
  • If Swallowed: Drink water and seek immediate medical attention.
  • If inhaled: Move to fresh air; seek help if symptoms persist.
  • Clothing: Remove contaminated clothing immediately and wash before reuse.
  • If symptoms persist after any exposure, seek medical advice and provide the product label or safety sheet to the healthcare provider.

Storage Tips

  • Store in a sealed container in a cool, dry, well-ventilated location.
  • Protect from freezing.
  • Keep the container tightly closed when not in use.
  • Store away from food, feed, and potable water supplies.
  • Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight or high heat.

Active Ingredients Declaration

All active ingredients in Soil Vitality Max are derived from registered and/or exempt materials and formulated in compliance with applicable Canadian and international agricultural standards.

item.content:encoded:
Explore More at Vertui.com Maximize Vigor

Vigor Spray
Max

Spray Vigor, Cultivate Strength

Maximize Your Plant’s Vigor Today!

Vigor Spray Max
Product Overview

Vigor Spray Max is a super-concentrated foliar fertilizer designed to invigorate plant growth, enhance resilience, and improve nutrient uptake. Safe for use on lawns, gardens, flowers, vegetables, and ornamental plants, it delivers nutrients directly to foliage for rapid absorption and visible results.

It’s the go-to treatment for gardeners, lawn care enthusiasts, and growers who want faster recovery from stress and consistent, vibrant plant performance.

Key Benefits

Enhances Plant
Resilience

Formulated to help plants stay strong and vigorous throughout the growing season, supporting their natural ability to thrive in changing conditions.

Supports Healthy
Growth

Promotes lush, vibrant lawns, thriving gardens, and flourishing ornamental plants by providing the nutrients they need for consistent development.

Improves Nutrient
Uptake

Designed for effective foliar feeding, allowing plants to efficiently absorb and use essential nutrients for optimal results.

Versatile Use

Ideal for a wide variety of plants, including lawns, gardens, flowers, vegetables, and ornamentals, making it a flexible choice for all your growing needs.

Simple Application

Easy to measure, mix, and apply, whether using a fine mist spray bottle for small areas or a yard sprayer for larger spaces.

Pet-Friendly

Suitable for outdoor areas where pets are present, providing peace of mind while maintaining the appearance of your plants.

Struggling with Plant Performance?

Vigor Spray Max was developed specifically for gardeners and growers who are dealing with:

Pale, yellowing, or weak leaves despite fertilizing

Delivers essential nutrients directly to the foliage, enhancing absorption and supporting plants in maintaining a healthy, vibrant appearance.

Damage after heat or
drought spells

Supports plant resilience during the growing season, helping them stay strong when weather conditions change.

Slowed growth during peak season

Provides consistent nutrient availability through foliar application, helping plants maintain steady development.

Poor flowering or reduced yield

Encourages overall plant health and vigour, supporting better bloom potential and sustained garden beauty.

Plants not bouncing back after stress

Helps plants maintain their strength and vitality, allowing them to recover more effectively during the growing season.

General lack of lushness or vibrancy

Invigorates plant growth and supports healthier foliage, enhancing the overall appearance and vitality of your lawn or garden.

How Vigor Spray Max Works

Vigor Spray Max gives plants the nutrients they need exactly where they need
them quickly and effectively, delivering fast, visible results.

  • Here’s why it works:
  • Direct Foliar Feeding: Bypasses soil limitations by delivering nutrients straight to the leaves for rapid absorption and immediate use in plant growth and health.
  • Amino Acids: Help plants use nutrients more efficiently, supporting steady growth and overall resilience throughout the season.
  • Chelated Micronutrients: Stay available to plants for longer, ensuring a consistent supply of essential trace elements for balanced growth and development.
  • Photosynthesis Boost: Supports rich leaf colour, energy production, and overall plant vitality through healthy chlorophyll activity.
  • Consistent Seasonal Support: Applied every 14-21 days, it helps maintain steady nutrient levels for strong, vibrant plants throughout the entire season.
  • Vigor Spray Max feeds plants directly through their leaves, improving nutrient uptake, resilience, and growth from the first application.

When to Use Vigor Spray Max

Peak Growth & Stress Recovery

Apply Vigor Spray Max when:

Plants are in active vegetative growth.

Recovery is needed after environmental stress events.

Flowering is underway, and you want to support quality and productivity.

Use throughout the growing season, reapplying every 14-21 days for best results.

Guaranteed Minimum Nutrient Analysis

Nutrient Component Percentage Description
Total Nitrogen (N) 7% Promotes lush, green growth by fueling leaf development and overall plant vigor.
Phosphoric Acid (P₂O₅) 13%  Enhances root health, energy transfer, and the development of strong flowering and fruiting structures.
Sulphur (S) 5%  Supports protein formation, improves leaf colour, and aids in chlorophyll production for healthy foliage.
Iron (Fe) (EDTA) 0.17% Prevents yellowing by supporting chlorophyll synthesis, helping leaves stay vibrant and green.
Manganese (Mn) (EDTA) 0.05% It aids photosynthesis, enzyme activation, and the breakdown of carbohydrates for plant energy.
Zinc (Zn-EDTA) 0.09%  Supports the production of growth hormones and enzymes needed for leaf expansion and development.
Copper (Cu) (EDTA) 0.05% Strengthens cell walls, aids reproductive growth, and helps plants defend against disease.
Molybdenum (Mo) (EDTA) 0.07% Improves nitrogen use efficiency, aiding in the conversion of nitrogen into plant proteins.
Boron (B) 0.016% Supports flowering, pollen development, and the movement of sugars and nutrients within the plant.

Coverage

250 mL (8.5 US fl oz)

Treats up to 1,012 L (267 gallons), covering up to 10,890 sq ft (1,012 sq m).

500 mL (17 US fl oz)

Treats up to 2,023 L (534 gallons), covering up to 21,780 sq ft (2,023 sq m).

Coverage may vary depending on the application method, type of sprayer, plant density, and weather conditions.

When to Apply Vigor Spray Max

Vegetables & Garden Beds

When to Apply

  • During active vegetative growth for strong foliage development.
  • Every 14-21 days through the growing season to maintain nutrient availability.

Pro Tips

  • Apply early in the morning or late in the afternoon to avoid leaf burn.
  • Ensure even foliar coverage, but stop before droplets form on leaves.

Fruit Trees, Vines & Berries

When to Apply

  • At early leaf-out in spring for a boost in growth.
  • Reapply every 14-21 days, coinciding with the stages of fruit set and development.

Pro Tips

  • Use a fine mist setting for thorough coverage of the leaves.
  • Avoid spraying during high winds or when rain is expected within 24 hours.

Flowers & Ornamentals

When to Apply

  • Early in the growth cycle for vibrant foliage and blooms.
  • Repeat every 14-21 days throughout the flowering period.

Pro Tips

  • Apply to both upper and lower leaf surfaces for best absorption.
  • Use as part of your regular ornamental care program for season-long colour.

Lawns & Turf

When to Apply

  • In early spring, as growth begins, it continues every 14-21 days through active growing months.
  • After mowing to encourage rapid recovery and green-up.

Pro Tips

  • Apply evenly using a yard sprayer at the recommended dilution.
  • Avoid heavy foot traffic immediately after application to allow the product to absorb.

How to Apply Vigor Spray Max

Hand Spraying
(Small Areas)

  • Mix 25-30 mL (0.85-1 US fl oz) per 1 L (34 US fl oz) of water.
  • Apply as a fine mist, coating all upper and lower leaf surfaces without dripping.
  • DO NOT OVER-SPRAY. Stop before droplets form on the foliage.

Backpack or Yard Sprayers
(Larger Areas)

  • Use the same dilution ratio (25-30 mL (0.85-1 US fl oz) per 1 L (34 US fl oz) for larger coverage.
  • Apply evenly across the target area to ensure thorough coverage of the leaves.
  • Adjust the nozzle to a fine mist setting for uniform application.

Optional Applications

Targeted Stress Recovery

  • Apply at the first signs of heat stress, drought damage, or nutrient deficiency.
  • Reapply within 14-21 days as part of your regular schedule.

Supplementary Boost for High-Value Plants

  • Use during peak growth stages or before flowering to support canopy health and energy production.

Mixing & Application Tips

  • Use clean water for mixing. If using municipal water, let it stand for 24 hours to allow the chlorine to dissipate.
  • Mix thoroughly before and during application to keep nutrients evenly suspended.
  • Apply during cooler parts of the day (early morning or late afternoon) to reduce evaporation and prevent leaf scorch.
  • Avoid spraying during rain, high wind, or high humidity to maximize absorption.
  • Store in a cool, dry place and use within the season for best results.

Seasonal Timing

Early Spring

March - April
  • Begin applications as lawns, gardens, and ornamental plants start to actively grow. Supports early leaf development, boosts resilience, and prepares plants for the season ahead.

Mid-Spring to Early Summer

March - June
  • Apply during seeding, transplanting, or early vegetative growth to encourage strong foliage and healthy root-supported growth. Helps establish a vibrant canopy and improve nutrient uptake.

Mid-Summer

July
  • Apply to maintain plant vitality during peak growth and summer heat stress. Ideal for long-season crops, perennials, and ornamentals that need consistent feeding.

Late Summer to Early Fall

August - September
  • Reinforce plant health ahead of seasonal changes. Helps lawns, flowers, and late-season crops maintain strength and appearance before cooler temperatures arrive.

Reapply Every 14-21 Days:
For optimal results, apply foliar fertilizers regularly during active growth to maintain continuous nutrient availability, enhance resilience, and achieve season-long plant performance.

Common Questions & Tips

Can I apply Vigor Spray Max with other foliar sprays?

Yes, it is generally compatible with most herbicides, fungicides, and insecticides. Always perform a jar test before mixing to check for compatibility.

Will overuse harm my plants?

Excessive application can cause leaf burn or nutrient imbalance. Always follow the recommended dilution rate of (25-30 ml (0.85-1 US fl oz) per 1 litre (34 US fl oz) and the 14-21 day reapplication schedule.

How soon can I expect to see results?

Many plants show improved colour and vigour within 7–10 days, with continued improvements over multiple applications.

Is Vigor Spray Max safe for edible crops and pets?

Yes, it can be used on edible plants and is safe around pets when applied as directed.

Can I apply Vigor Spray Max during hot weather?

Yes, but always apply early in the morning or late in the afternoon to reduce evaporation and minimize the risk of leaf scorch.

How often should I reapply for stressed plants?

 For plants under heat, drought, or pest stress, you may reapply every 14-21 days as part of your regular schedule. Avoid making more frequent applications unless advised by a professional agronomist.

Can I use Vigor Spray Max in a greenhouse?

Absolutely. It is effective in greenhouse environments, provided good air circulation is ensured so that leaves dry properly after application.

Will rain wash off the product?

 If rain occurs within 2-3 hours of spraying, some effectiveness may be reduced. If heavy rainfall happens shortly after application, reapply at the next scheduled interval.

Safety, Handling & Storage

Safe Use Guidelines

  • Use only as directed.
  • Keep out of reach of children
  • Avoid contact with the eyes or skin.
  • Wear gloves and goggles for large or frequent mixes.
  • Do not inhale spray mist.
  • Wash your hands thoroughly after handling, even if you are wearing gloves.
  • Do not eat, drink, or smoke while using this product.
  • Avoid application on windy days to minimize drift.

First Aid

  • Eyes: Flush with clean water for 15 minutes.
  • Skin: Wash with soap and water.
  • If swallowed: Drink water and seek immediate medical attention.
  • If Inhaled: Move to fresh air; seek help if symptoms persist.
  • Clothing: Remove contaminated clothing immediately and wash before reuse.
  • If symptoms persist after any exposure, seek medical advice and provide the product label or safety sheet to the healthcare provider.

Storage Tips

  • Store in a sealed container in a cool, dry, well-ventilated location.
  • Protect from freezing.
  • Keep the container tightly closed when not in use.
  • Store away from food, feed, and potable water supplies.
  • Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight or high heat.
  • The product contains active micronutrients; use according to soil test results for optimal safety.

Active Ingredients Declaration

All active ingredients in Vigor Spray Max are derived from registered and/or exempt materials and formulated in compliance with applicable Canadian and international agricultural standards.
